families.mechanism: A broad directional participation shock may persist across the next sessions.
Exceptional relative dispersion may represent temporary forced deleveraging.
families.observable: closed 4-bar return dispersion versus lagged 48-bar baseline

families.failure: jump is a one-bar liquidation wick
families.mechanism: Volatility compression followed by a jump may indicate a new information regime.
families.observable: closed 8/48-bar realized absolute returns and current move

families.failure: funding sign does not proxy positioning
families.mechanism: A newly settled crowded side with opposite price drift may unwind.
families.observable: last settled funding and closed 4-bar return

families.mechanism: Broad directional flow with broad volume participation may underreact.
families.observable: closed cross-sectional breadth and volume relative to lagged 48 bars

families.failure: residual estimate is unstable or BTC beta dominates
families.mechanism: Idiosyncratic drift with low market beta may persist independent of BTC.
families.observable: closed BTC returns, lagged beta and residual momentum

limitations: Current spread, rules and fee schedule are not historical time series
REST book is a collection snapshot, not historical queue depth
OHLCV volume is not aggressor-signed trade flow
Funding uses settlement rates and entry-notional approximation
14-day fresh slice cannot satisfy 28 independent forward days
no calibrated historical queue/maker adverse selection
multiple_testing: six family paths; no inferential claim with fewer than 28 independent days
selection: highest one-day net R among two preregistered thresholds; tie lower threshold

unsupported_plans.candidate_ranking: Too few independent prospective folds to train and validate a meta-ranker
unsupported_plans.depth_asymmetry: Only collection-time depth, no historical depth sequence
unsupported_plans.maker_adverse_selection: No calibrated queue position or maker fill outcomes
unsupported_plans.meta_labeling: No independent labeled fill/outcome sample of adequate duration
unsupported_plans.multi_horizon_trend_continuation: Earlier trend paths consumed; no distinct untested mechanism specified
unsupported_plans.orderbook_imbalance: Only seconds-long prospective book samples, no matched outcomes
unsupported_plans.short_horizon_microstructure: Seconds-long recorder samples cannot support chronological folds
unsupported_plans.trade_flow_imbalance: Only seconds-long prospective trade samples, no matched outcomes
unsupported_plans.volatility_expansion_reversal: Only one short fresh regime; insufficient volatility episodes
